Camera-Up Yaw Stability Experiment

True yaw is intentionally held constant. The transformed image simulates a camera above the eye (+5/+10 deg), then the trained model is used to compare old and new yaw predictions. Aggregate plots use all rows; the image viewer shows 50 of 50 rows.
